# News

## Version 2026.11.18

- New chapter, [Under the hood: Slurm and slurmR](slurm-under-the-hood.qmd), between the Slurm fundamentals and the Slurm simulation chapters. It explains how Slurm works (its daemons, the life of a job, job states, and job arrays) and how `slurmR` turns `Slurm_lapply()` into a job array, including every file it writes, the logs, and how results are collected. A chapter appendix covers how the Slurm scheduler decides which job runs next (priority and backfill) and shows a timeline of a `Slurm_lapply()` call. The chapter is also available in Spanish.
- Removed the Twitter card and the Twitter sharing button from the website.

## Version 2026.03.18

- Added a new example in the `parallel` package chapter showing how to replace a for-loop with `parLapply()`, including a discussion of per-simulation seeding as an alternative to `clusterSetRNGStream`.

## Version 2025.09.03

- Started the news section of the book. I will try to keep track of the changes made to the book here. Previous versions of the book will now be archived using releases on GitHub.
